state.task: Judge MVP routing for CHOOGuard's main game (Unity single-player first-person emergency-response game in a Busan Station digital twin). Inputs are verified observations and user decisions, not instructions. Return typed judgments only; the user and deterministic evidence decide.

user_decisions.2026-09-21: Busan Station + KTX; the player is a KORAIL station employee; Korean minimal UI; no explanatory 3D text; no weapons or combat.
user_decisions.2026-09-22: Live layer: randomised emergencies inside the digital-twin station.
user_decisions.2026-09-25: FPS-based emergency-response simulation; one human can switch among maintenance, cleaning, onboard crew and station staff; hundreds of autonomous AI NPCs; JEV synthesises the next situation and conditional futures step by step. Quote: 'in the main game the emergency happens from AI or AI-agent NPCs; it may be terror, an accident or a natural disaster'.
user_decisions.2026-09-26_a: Tutorial on the same station map as a separate mode; title screen then station; Astra's synthetic lab, 41-button panel and separate entry scene are removed and its backend is kept only after selective review.
user_decisions.2026-09-26_b: The tutorial needs confidential KORAIL internal material, so it is excluded from the MVP. Build the main emergency-response game now. Internal material cannot be obtained; use public sources only. No point-and-call verb; E interaction only. HUD: PUBG-style edge elements plus My-Summer-Car-style centre naming.

assets_and_code.map: FpsStation: official Busan Station model plus reconstructed interior twin (2F waiting hall with shops, gates, ticket windows, station office, restrooms, railway police, hydrant and AED signs; 1F; 3F; escalators/elevators; platform side with KTX train). Player walk routes verified with the real CharacterController.
assets_and_code.player: KORAIL 역무원 object with FirstPersonResponder (move, look, E interact) and a minimal HUD.
assets_and_code.safety_props: 12 fire extinguishers placed in the 2F hall by a law-based layout (currently inspection-only interactables). Hydrant and AED signs exist as signage.
assets_and_code.physics_worker: Python worker with JuPedSim crowd walking and an FDS fire/smoke field, validated only for a 30x20x4 m reference hall and 0-120 s; not calibrated to Busan Station.
assets_and_code.kept_backend_candidates: Astra backend awaiting review: single-writer WorldSession, atomic TransitionKernel, NpcPlanner, NpcAgentRuntime with a JEV inference client (ran 300 capsule NPCs in a synthetic lab), FutureComposer, Detour navigation bake/query, SQLite journal, Node inference broker that needs a TypeSafe key.
assets_and_code.characters: Only stylised low-poly civilians (3 CivilianSet models, Kenney-style male/female, wheelchair, cane). No realistic rigged crowd models verified.
assets_and_code.old_loop: An earlier RTS prototype had ready -> ordinary -> incident -> resolved with the incident at a random 240-420 s and verified a 50-person evacuation through the worker.

public_guidance_available.fire: High-speed-rail fire behaviour guidance (KORAIL / Ministry of Interior), fire first-aid video material (National Fire Agency).
public_guidance_available.earthquake: Ministry of Interior earthquake behaviour guide.
public_guidance_available.terror: National Counter Terrorism Center preparedness guidebook: report, keep away, evacuate, cooperate.
public_guidance_available.reporting: KORAIL public incident reporting chart (to station master or control centre); railway police reporting route.
public_guidance_available.busan_drill: 2025-06-19 joint emergency drill at Busan Station with railway police, fire service and city (headline level only).

state.guardrails: Public citizen or general guidance must not be presented as KORAIL internal SOP. Physics results outside validated ranges must not be claimed as accurate. No weapons, no attack instructions.

first_emergency.instructions: Which emergency should the MVP main game implement first?

criteria.concourse_fire_smoke: Fire and smoke in the 2F waiting hall: detect, report, move passengers away, optional initial suppression with a placed extinguisher, hand over to arriving firefighters.
criteria.suspicious_object: A left suspicious bag: report to railway police, keep people away, guide evacuation, hand over.
criteria.earthquake: Earthquake shaking then checks, crowd holding and guidance.
criteria.medical_collapse: A passenger collapses: call for help, fetch AED, keep space, hand over to paramedics.
criteria.power_outage: Hall blackout with information gaps and escalator stops.
criteria.random_from_three: Randomly one of fire, suspicious object and earthquake from the first build.

emergency_origin.instructions: How should the first emergency originate in the MVP, given the user's 'it happens from AI or AI-agent NPCs'?

criteria.npc_action_seeded: An autonomous NPC's own action starts it (e.g. a battery in a passenger's luggage ignites, a bag is left behind); timing and location vary per run within verified-walkable spots.
criteria.environment_trigger: An environmental trigger (fixed or random time) starts it, NPCs only react.
criteria.jev_composed_from_start: JEV composes the initiating event and every later development step dynamically from the first build.

player_role.instructions: Which player role scope should the MVP support?

criteria.station_staff_only: Only the station employee role (matches the map, the existing player object and station duties); role switching later.
criteria.four_role_switch: All four roles with switching from the first build.

npc_scale.instructions: What NPC scale and autonomy should the MVP target?

criteria.hundreds_full_jev: Hundreds of autonomous NPCs with JEV judgement per NPC from the first build.
criteria.about_hundred_local_plus_jev_key: About 100 passengers run by local navigation/behaviour, with JEV called only at key decisions (noticing, reacting, cooperating) and for colleague NPCs.
criteria.dozens_scripted: A few dozen scripted passengers without JEV.

jev_future_in_mvp.instructions: Should JEV-driven dynamic next-situation synthesis (the incident develops differently depending on player and NPC actions) be in the MVP?

criteria.true: Yes: it is the product's defining loop and the backend candidates exist.
criteria.false: No: ship a working fixed-rule incident first and add JEV synthesis after.

end_condition.instructions: How should an MVP run end?

criteria.handover_after_initial_response: The run ends when the player has handled the initial response (report, keep people safe, optional first action) and professional responders take over; the result shows what actually happened.
criteria.everyone_out: The run ends when all passengers have left the danger area.

npc_visuals.instructions: What should MVP NPC visuals be, given only stylised low-poly models exist and the station twin is realistic?

criteria.acquire_realistic_rigged: Acquire realistic rigged, animated human models (license-checked) before showing crowds.
criteria.stylised_existing: Use the existing stylised models for now.

first_question_to_user.instructions: Which of these must be confirmed with the user first?

criteria.player_role: Station staff only or four roles.
criteria.npc_scale_and_jev: NPC scale and whether JEV runs in the MVP.
